archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & HAUTE PARFUMERIE (Cinematic Obsidian, Milled Gold, Crisp Warm White)
art_direction: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day caliber luxury fragrance store. Features kinetic hero reveals, spotlight product frames, numbered manifesto chapters for brand story, slow editorial marquee drift, lenis smooth scrolling, ambient canvas gold particle light glow, and seamless WhatsApp ordering.
theme: Dark Mode Default with Pure Gold & Velvet Obsidian accents

typography.headings_script: Pinyon Script, Alex Brush, Great Vibes, cursive
typography.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
typography.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight text-white

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Navigation Header
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Fixed backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070707]/80 border-b border-[#D4AF37]/20 z-50. Gold script logo image/svg, Nav links: Home, Shop, Story (#story), Contact, Admin, and 'Order on WhatsApp' quick CTA button.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Hero Section
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Kinetic line-by-line reveal animation. Title 'Meè & U' in elegant gold script + 'Perfume & Attar' in tall serif. Subtext: 'Crafted in small batches with pure oil-based formulations for an enduring sillage.' Two CTAs: 'Explore Collection' (scrolls to catalog) & 'Order on WhatsApp'. Elegant dark ambient canvas background with floating gold shimmer particles. NO bottle image in hero as specified.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Est. 2025 · Mumbai
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Centered editorial line flanked by subtle gold hairline rules: 'Est. 2025 · Mumbai'.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Trust Badges
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Three minimal gold-bordered cards with luxury line icons: 1. Pure Oil-Based (Non-alcoholic, rich botanical extracts) 2. Long-Lasting (12+ hours enduring sillage) 3. Small-Batch (Hand-poured in Mumbai atelier).

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Featured Attars
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Section label 'Signature Scents'. Spotlight cards for 'Oud Royale' (Combodian Oud, Smoked Amber, Taif Rose) and 'Musk Al Ameer' (White Musk, Sandalwood, Golden Honey). Includes olfactory notes, size selectors (6ml/12ml), pricing, and Instant WhatsApp order deep-link.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Featured Perfumes
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Section label 'Refined EDPs'. Spotlight cards for 'Midnight Bloom' (Black Plum, Vanilla Absolute, Night Jasmine) and 'Ocean Breeze' (Sea Salt, Driftwood, Crisp Bergamot). Includes fragrance pyramid breakdown, size options (50ml/100ml), pricing, and WhatsApp order trigger.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: View All Products Action
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Prominent full-width or pill-shaped gold button 'View All Products' navigating or expanding to the full shop filter catalog.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Special Offers & Combos
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Special combo bundles (e.g. 'Royal Oud & Musk Duo', 'Discovery Quintet'). Dynamically hidden if no active offers exist in state/admin.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Our Story
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: id='story'. Heading 'A tribute to timeless fragrance.' Structured into numbered manifesto chapters: '01 / The Origin', '02 / The Alchemy', '03 / The Sillage' with editorial storytelling on Mumbai craftsmanship.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Slow Editorial Marquee
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Infinite slow drifting marquee with low contrast gold text: 'HAND-POURED IN MUMBAI · PURE OIL-BASED FORMULATION · NO SYNTHETIC DILUTION · ENDURING SILLAGE · EXTRACT DE PARFUM · BATCH 2025'

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: WhatsApp Conversion Band
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: High impact conversion banner: 'Order on WhatsApp. Delivered to your door.' Large glowing WhatsApp direct order CTA button.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Footer
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Gold script logo image + Explore links (Shop, Story, Attars, EDPs, Offers) + Contact block (Mumbai Atelier address, phone, email) + Admin login link + copyright.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Shop Catalog & Filtering
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Interactive tab filters: 'All', 'Signature Attars', 'Refined Perfumes', 'Special Offers/Combos'. Search input by fragrance name or note (e.g., Oud, Rose, Musk, Ocean). Sort by Price/Popularity.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Product Detail Page / Quick View Modal
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Olfactory Pyramid visual (Top Notes, Heart Notes, Base Notes), bottle size selector with real-time price updates, quantity selector, and pre-formatted WhatsApp order builder ('Hi Meè & U, I want to order...').

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Contact & Inquiry
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: EmailJS form integration, store locator details in Mumbai, direct WhatsApp help link, and FAQ accordion.

exact_sections_order_and_copy.name: Admin Dashboard
exact_sections_order_and_copy.details: Password-protected modal/route (`/admin` or header trigger). Manage Products (CRUD), Manage Active Special Offers (Toggle active/inactive), and Update WhatsApp Phone Numbers.

component_design_specs.cards: Dark obsidian slate `#0A0A0A` with 1px border `border-[#D4AF37]/20` and subtle inner gold gradient glow on hover (`hover:border-[#D4AF37]/60 hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]`). Padded generously with `p-6 sm:p-8`.

buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#F8F8F6] font-medium tracking-wider uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm py-3.5 px-8 rounded-none border border-[#D4AF37]/40 hover:border-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-all duration-300

component_design_specs.badges: bg-[#141414] text-[#D4AF37] border border-[#D4AF37]/30 text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] px-3 py-1 rounded-none

whatsapp_integration.message_template: Hi Meè & U! I'd like to order: {product_name} ({size}) - Price: ₹{price}. Please share payment and delivery details.
whatsapp_integration.combo_template: Hi Meè & U! I'm interested in the Special Offer: {combo_title} - Price: ₹{price}.

data_testid_guidelines: Every interactive button, link, input, tab, card, and modal element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: data-testid='hero-explore-button', data-testid='hero-whatsapp-button', data-testid='product-card-oud-royale', data-testid='add-to-cart-whatsapp-button', data-testid='admin-login-submit', data-testid='shop-tab-attars'.
